Follow the selected upstream version’s instructions when changing it.

instructions.title: Build the Mac app with upstream setup
instructions.instruction: On an Apple Silicon Mac, use PadMint 0.5.1 or newer with Xcode and your own Mario Kart Wii PAL RMCP01 revision 0 disc. Choose Mario Kart Wii and This Mac, then move the resulting KartPad.app to Applications. Upstream lists macOS 14 or newer and describes the Mac version as experimental. Follow the linked guide if PadMint cannot download its tools or does not show This Mac; keep your existing game files and certificate verification.

instructions.title: Reuse your prepared game files
instructions.instruction: When KartPad first opens, select your own extracted game data. The linked Mac guide shows how to copy the matching version’s prepared disc folder from PadMint into a location you will keep, so you do not need to prepare it again. Retro Rewind needs the matching compiled version and its separate full data pack; keep the whole enclosing data folder because it can also contain saves. Building, importing and opening the app remain explicit upstream steps.

instructions.title: Keep saves when replacing the app
instructions.instruction: For newer Mac versions, build another app with PadMint, quit the current app and replace it through upstream’s instructions. Original settings and saves live in ~/Library/Application Support/KartPad; graphics caches are in ~/Library/Caches/KartPad. Keep Retro Rewind’s selected data folder too. The ready-made Mac downloads from 0.7.9 through 0.7.13 remain historical alternatives and no longer receive updates. Android uses its own APK and updater; iPhone/iPad use the separate PadMint and signing route. Portcove does not run PadMint, sign Apple apps, manage these bundles or back up their external data.

instructions.title: Prepare your own game
instructions.instruction: Extract the complete official Windows archive. Create data beside ge007.x86_64.exe and copy your own US NTSC-U ROM there as ge007.ntsc-final.z64. Register ge007.x86_64.exe as the external player; prepare-assets/ge007-convert.exe is a setup helper, not the play target.

instructions.title: Choose Play to finish upstream setup
instructions.instruction: The first explicit Play generates asset sidecars from the verified ROM using the included upstream converter. Later starts reuse those files. Downloading and read-only discovery do not run the converter or the game.

instructions.title: Update without carrying obsolete assets
instructions.instruction: Follow upstream’s update guide: extract a new version separately and copy only your ROM, data/ge007.eep and data/ge007.ini, retaining the old copy. Do not carry generated pcmodels-* or pccg-* folders; the new player must regenerate them. Keep any emulator save backup too. This version-dependent in-folder generation does not fit the current native-portable persistence contract. Runtime updates stay with you/upstream, and external data stays outside Portcove backups.

Choose a new TRX folder, separate from your current working copy and original games. Select the packs you want and provide your own supported original Steam, GOG or disc installations. instructions.title: Choose the installed player
instructions.instruction: When setup finishes, choose TRX.exe from the folder you installed into, using that folder as its working directory. Choose the game pack in TRX. Save the launch details in Portcove, then choose Play separately. The downloaded installer is not the game executable.

instructions.title: Keep the working copy when updating
instructions.instruction: You or upstream own runtime updates and the combined game folders. Prepare a new version separately and keep the current copy until it works. The upstream installer overwrites target files and removes unchecked game packs, so do not point it at your only working copy. Keep separate copies of saves, cfg settings and any custom data. Portcove registration does not back up, roll back or delete this external tree. The Windows/Linux manual ZIP route is also available upstream; follow its exact original-file mapping rather than copying an entire disc into the player folder.

instructions.title: Keep your files and update through upstream

Follow the selected upstream version’s instructions when changing it.

instructions.instruction: Use upstream PadMint 0.5.5 or newer on an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode. Choose SunPad, your own Super Mario Sunshine USA revision 0 GMSE01 raw ISO/GCM, and This Mac. instructions.title: Choose the original image in SunPad

instructions.title: Keep the app data when updating
instructions.instruction: Build a newer app separately and follow upstream’s replacement instructions while keeping your current working copy. Mac configuration, extracted game data, saves, logs and controller profiles are under ~/Library/Application Support/SunPad; keep a separate backup before replacing or re-preparing anything. iPhone/iPad signing identity and experimental Apple TV’s purgeable storage have separate rules in the platform guides. Portcove does not manage bundle replacement, back up this external data or promise runtime rollback. Check upstream’s known issues before replacing a working app.
